description: This Java class defines utility methods for database operations related to the 'DeliveryPerson' entity, including validation, creation, update, and deletion, in the context of a grocery ordering system.

classes.name: DeliveryPersonDBUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing database operations for DeliveryPerson entities.

methods.name: validateDeliveryPerson
methods.description: Validates a delivery person based on email and password, returning a DeliveryPerson object if credentials are correct.

methods.name: insertDeliveryPerson
methods.description: Inserts a new delivery person record into the database with provided details.

methods.name: updateDP
methods.description: Updates delivery person details, including vehicle number and city, along with associated employee info.

methods.name: deleteDeliveryPerson
methods.description: Deletes a delivery person and associated employee record based on Employee ID.

methods.name: updateDPWithoutImage
methods.description: Updates delivery person details without changing the image, along with associated employee info.
